summary: Implemented sprint alternate views and query-backed view tabs. The sprint route now preserves URL filters while switching Kanban, table, dependency, timeline, and progress views. Added dense table scanning, dependency diagnostics with scoped cycle and stale blocker visibility, status timeline review, sprint progress bars, server query propagation, query-safe route matching, and expanded console smoke coverage for every sprint view.
